registry: Approach B V3.2 stage 2 (exhaustive top-M + clean X/Y scorer retraining)
preregistered_at: 2026-11-17T02:30+05:30, before any Phase C TRAIN label or any new-scorer outcome was observed

fixed.sampler: frozen task cVAE q2init_all (V3_TASK_STAGE v3_3), seed-0 per-root generator, 64 MC draws, top-6 destinations; M4/M5 = nested prefixes
fixed.teachers: unchanged X/Y teachers via construct.verify / onpolicy._v3_job; hosts admitted only after the predeclared parity sample (PARITY_V32.json)

experiments.question: Is the integrated exhaustive implementation exact?
experiments.gate: all tests pass; nested M4<M5<M6; selectors == xy.choose

experiments.question: Does removing the B cap at fixed frozen model change PHYSICAL success?
experiments.controlled_variable: candidate pool (capped M4 B=4096 vs exhaustive M4/M5/M6)
experiments.reference: capped M4 B=4096, frozen V3 D s0, VAL
experiments.labels: every newly selected repair physically verified (Phase B)
experiments.metrics: task success K1-K3 (+per K), no-op, NONE abstention, NONE->verified success; root-paired delta, 2,000 bootstrap
experiments.interpretation: delta<0 with CI excl. 0 => frozen scorer mis-ranks the larger pool (supports E3); delta>0 => coverage gain realised; CI incl. 0 => inconclusive

experiments.question: Does physically labelled expanded-distribution TRAIN evidence improve D's ranking?
experiments.reference: D-control: xy.fit arm D on snapshot abf_v3_e8a496bc66266fca (the frozen V3 D's data)
experiments.treatment: D-expanded: same + V3.2 Phase C TRAIN labels (new immutable snapshot)
experiments.matching: identical architecture, torch seed (=> identical init), batch partition seed, AdamW lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4, batch 64, FIXED 60 epochs (patience disabled), checkpoint = best epoch by VAL NLL on the identical base VAL labels; seeds 0,1,2 after a seed-0 smoke run; same TRAIN root list (only label sets differ)
experiments.evaluation: exhaustive M4/M5/M6 on VAL with the frozen sampler and frozen rule; every selected repair physically verified; seed-averaged per-root success, root-paired bootstrap D-expanded vs D-control on identical candidate sets
experiments.primary_metric: VAL verified task success K1-K3 at M4, M5, M6 (all reported; no single-M cherry pick)
experiments.interpretation: expanded > control with CI excl. 0 at >=1 M and no M significantly worse => evidence helps; otherwise null / harmful reported as is

experiments.question: Does one D-expanded generalise across M4/M5/M6?
experiments.evaluation: same D-expanded models on all three nested pools

experiments.question: Is M-specific fitting necessary? (CONDITIONAL)
experiments.activation_condition: BOTH (a) for D-expanded (seed mean) VAL verified task success at M6 < M4 by >=3 points with root-paired 95% CI excluding 0 in a domain, AND (b) on those roots the M6 selection's p11 calibration (mean p11 minus verified success of the selected repair) exceeds the M4 value by >=0.05; otherwise NOT_RUN
experiments.if_activated: M4-only and M6-only trained D (matched label count and optimizer steps), cross-tested on M4/M5/M6; M5-only only if M4 vs M6 leaves an interpolation question

experiments.question: Generalisation and cost
experiments.evaluation: frozen configuration on exposed TEST (regression only) and, if safely feasible, a fresh family-disjoint cohort; else FRESH_CONFIRMATION_NOT_RUN

phase_C_sampling_design.roots: TRAIN only; stratified by K_legacy (1,2,3,0,NONE) in sha256('v32c|'+root_id) order (v32c.roots); pilot 2D 8/8/8/4/4, 3D 6/6/6/3/3; full counts set after the pilot from measured cost
phase_C_sampling_design.items_per_root: label-blind and seeded (v32c.items): frozen-rule top-1 at M4/M5/M6, next 2 highest-p11, one seeded reservoir draw per p11 band [0.3,0.9),[0.1,0.3),[0,0.1), one uniform draw, every other order of the M6 top-1 assignment and of up to 2 known successful assignments; exact duplicates of existing X labels dropped
phase_C_sampling_design.teacher_queries: onpolicy.v3_label: Y once per canonical endpoint; X where Y=1 or seeded-flagged (1/3), X|Y=0 kept; unresolved = MISSING (censored)
